name: Wispr Flow
free_plan_limits: 2,000 words a week on Mac and Windows
since_note: Wispr Flow launched on Mac around September 30, 2024 (Business Wire).
best_for: Fast dictation into any app, with cleanup
notes: Pro is $15/user monthly or $144 a year ($12/mo). Free limits differ by device (iPhone about 550 words, Android 2,500). Students get 50% off. Offline use not stated.

name: OpenAI Whisper
free_plan_limits: Open-source model is free to run on your own computer
usage_note: $0.006 per minute through the OpenAI API
notes: Whisper is a speech model, not a typing app; you need other software around it. MIT license. Priced the free model; hosted API is $0.006/min.

name: Glaido
best_for: Unlimited voice typing for a flat fee
notes: Pro is $20 monthly or $17/mo billed yearly, unlimited words. Pricing page and blog differ slightly. Not stated: supported devices and offline use.

name: Superwhisper
free_plan_limits: Unlimited dictation with local models, no expiry
since_note: Mac app first released August 2023 (wiki aggregator; secondary).
best_for: Private dictation that runs on your device
notes: Pro is $8.49 monthly, $84.99 a year or $249.99 one-time. One license covers all your devices. Free includes a 3,000-word Pro trial. 30-day refund.

name: Willow
free_plan_limits: Not clear: newer posts say no cap, a May post says 2,000 words a week
best_for: Voice typing with built-in writing cleanup
notes: Individual $15 monthly or $12/mo yearly; Team $12 monthly or $10/user yearly. All figures come from Willow's blog, not a pricing page. Not stated: devices and offline use.
